page.notes: The first entries of the left column and the top of the right column are cut by the binding; several words are doubtful, e.g. "Gadidolum" (probably "Ad idolum"), "Forma Dei quid", "Hæreditas Hebræis quid" where the initial letter H is set in a decorative form, and the "σωτηρεσ" Greek line is only approximate.
